recognize_zh: 抹片中有一顆遠大於周圍細胞的大型細胞，具兩個相對的腎形核、細緻染色質與灰藍色豐富胞質，旁邊只有一個小細胞核作比例；這種巨大多核／腎形核的淋巴瘤細胞是 ALCL 標誌細胞在抹片上的樣貌。
features: Single very large cell, many times the size of the adjacent small nucleus
Two large reniform/lobated nuclei facing each other, with finely granular chromatin and a paranuclear clear zone
Abundant grayish-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders and a few small vacuoles
Background with platelet clumps and stripped debris; no granules in the large cell
describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained aspirate smear shows a single very large atypical cell with abundant gray-blue, slightly vacuolated cytoplasm and two large reniform nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, arranged around a paranuclear clear zone. The cell is many times the size of an adjacent small bare nucleus. The background contains platelet clumps and debris without other hematopoietic elements in this field. The morphology is that of a large anaplastic lymphoid cell and, in the context of a known ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma, is suggestive of marrow involvement; confirmation by CD30/ALK immunostaining or flow cytometry is required.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus with coarse chromatin and granular pink cytoplasm, not two separate reniform nuclei with agranular blue cytoplasm.
RS cells have prominent inclusion-like macronucleoli, whereas this cell shows fine chromatin without large nucleoli, and ALCL is CD30/ALK-positive.
Osteoclasts have multiple uniform separate nuclei and granular cytoplasm, and carcinoma cells tend to cluster and are keratin-positive.
